U.note: Charming helmeted pelican with parallax, working pedal IK and extra night/reverse controls, but the wing just sits on the body and the bird looks a bit pasted on.

V.note: Clean outlined pelican with bell on the handlebar and spinning chainring, but the pale washed-out scene and wing not reaching the bars make it less lively.

W.note: Polished helmeted pelican with wing arm to the grip, trees and parallax; the bell as a checkbox with a faint puff is a weak control.

X.note: Largest, most convincing pelican with wing arm gripping the bars, bell on the handlebar, ding bubble, sunset sky and well-labelled keyboard-friendly controls.

Y.note: Strong helmeted pelican with blinking, honk bubble and keyboard shortcuts, though the dense monospace status line is cramped on a phone.

Z.note: Works and has trees and a ring message, but the pelican is small with a flat grey sheet for a wing, a salmon pouch, and a stray focus box on bell click.
